child_tool_info.description: Estimate relationships among supplied gene or sequence-feature members with BV-BRC GeneTree; retain the selected locus alignment, tree, branch measurements and explicit function/taxon associations.
child_tool_info.instructions: Assign GeneTree the supplied sequence-feature comparison and select each locus analysis explicitly. The native application produces a tree for each staged locus. For file inputs, the retained producer derives loci from the basename before its first dot, tokenizes FASTA headers and can suffix duplicate member labels; retain the original file/member identities and source-backed transformations. A selected gene_tree result is a per-locus view even when the same original task also requested concatenation. It does not by itself establish organismal relationships or a function assignment. Supply exact function/taxon records and injective tip mappings to an explicit supplied organismal tree when those comparisons are requested. Select native GeneTree sequences with explicit source types and alphabet DNA or Protein; RNA is not in the native enum. The retained producer requires at least four staged members. Bind actual Workspace files, feature groups, genome groups or inline feature IDs to their exact request parameter pointers. The retained feature_ids branch fetches protein sequence even when DNA was requested. A single declared aligned input bypasses alignment; multiple inputs are aligned per locus. Native recipes are RAxML, PhyML and FastTree. The inspected producer does not consume alignment_program or bootstrap as requested controls; it uses MAFFT for alignment and recipe-specific source defaults. Requested alphabet/model/threads and bootstrap values remain separate from actual observed settings. Preserve trim and gap-filter evidence without inventing original coordinates. Acquire complete final aligned FASTA or, for PhyML, relaxed sequential PHYLIP, and raw Newick plus any phyloXML derivative. The normal upload list omits separate engine log files even when produced locally. HTML command/report text is not an implemented log parser. PhyML/FastTree log measurements remain unavailable unless a supported explicit reader is supplied; an output filename cannot establish engine/model/support method. GeneTree XML conversion can insert missing branch lengths as zero and lose zero support. Preserve XML observations with those qualifications; prefer original raw Newick for original branch facts. A rooted XML marker is not biological rooting. Use the existing launch episode and its selected API child for the unchanged native assignment. The invocation schema also includes the existing results commission; its version identifies which assignment is supplied. api.bvbrc_appservice.prepare validates the selected application definition, original native parameters, inputs and output destination without submitting. Select workspace_metadata, workspace_create and upload separately when input preparation or transfer is needed. submit performs the selected AppService.start_app2 call and retains the actual request, response and original task identity. Use the resource-generic monitoring episode and selected status/query_tasks observations plus task_info stdout or stderr when relevant; retain native states, observation times and actual logs. Logs and process liveness do not prove productive execution, completion or throughput. Choose further observations within the episode; no polling cadence or automatic retry is supplied. Results can select task_info, workspace_metadata, list_outputs, download_capability and download to obtain the actual original-task artifacts. Retain task, Workspace path/UUID, manifest/association evidence and complete acquired bytes. A directory entry, HTML report or filename suffix does not prove format, task production or immutable producer-byte identity. Transfer/status/preparation facts receive no fabricated annotation-confidence score. This API route does not claim local scientific execution, live authentication, deployment or a successfully executed service job. Before results acquisition, select exact semantic roles and analysis-local artifact slots, reader format/dialect, original source-order tree indices, populations, calculation parameters and requested typed fields. The scientific mode is stored at adapter.parameters.analyses[].analysis.mode. A role alone is not proof of which locus/analysis produced an artifact. Pass exact source-backed input/member, row/tip, feature/family/genome, function and taxon joins through the originally selected scientific_inputs and supplied_metadata. Already acquired supplemental native documents also need their exact original supplied_contents byte bindings; nested JSON source identifiers do not authenticate them. The bound provider adapter uses the declared Newick, aligned FASTA, relaxed PHYLIP, RAxML partition, phyloXML, RAxML 8 log and, for CodonTree, native-table readers. Separate provider extractors populate the numerical sheet, and calculate_gene_tree or calculate_codon_tree computes the explicit selected components without network, job or model calls. Use the provider requested_form_schema finite selectors for numerical counts, gap/conservation/site measurements, branch/support rows, function composition, relationship comparisons and, for CodonTree, family measurements/membership; request requirements and qualifications when the receiver needs them. Known branch units, support methods, bootstrap denominators and original residue maps require actual evidence. Missing, not measured, failed, truncated, incompatible and measured zero remain distinct. Preserve valid independent partial data and signed native values. Branch support and native conservation/selection statistics are not calibrated annotation probabilities. Retain every originally selected analysis, complete native artifact, populated sheet, parameter set and component set internally. Recalculate saved sheets with explicit changed parameters without reacquiring data or rerunning analysis; historical observations remain unchanged. Return only the parent's originally requested typed numerical fields through the existing bvbrc_phylogeny return sources, with no model-composed restatement or automatic widening of that form.
child_tool_info.name: bvbrc.gene_tree.gene_tree

child_tool_info.description: Parse a registered supplied asset under a chosen wrapper interpretation. Preserve valid independent members and exact original custody; evidence never enlarges annotation targets.
child_tool_info.instructions:
Operation: material.parse

Parse a registered supplied asset under a chosen wrapper interpretation. Preserve valid independent members and exact original custody; evidence never enlarges annotation targets.

Use the actual local binding and its caller-owned resource limits. Read or measure only the assigned operands and explicit received inputs. Reuse retained outputs when the operation is a read; do not treat a read as a new measurement. Preserve native values, coordinate meanings, partial results and actionable failures. Job-specific operations require their original assigned execution.

Use exactly the separately supplied actual input_schema; required operands and allowed values come from that contract. Do not infer another callable, resource or environment from this entry.
